title: Equity—Costs of an Equity Transaction
summary: Addressed how transaction costs of an equity transaction should be accounted for, confirming they are deducted from equity. Withdrawn in 2003.

related.title: Financial Instruments: Presentation
related.relationship: The parent standard whose 2003 revision superseded SIC-17 by incorporating equity transaction cost treatment directly into IAS 32.37–38
